events.name: Motown Christmas
events.info: A Motown Christmas features a world-class vocal group, assembled from past and present members of Motown's most legendary groups...Ali Woodsons Temptations, The Miracles and The Contours. The vocalists are backed up by a 6 piece band. A Motown Christmas is a powerful family-oriented show combining Motown's greatest hits with everyone's favorite holiday classics. This show features those famous Motown trademarks...dazzling choreography and unforgettable harmonies all performed in that memorable, soulful Motown style. This is an evening not to be missed, bring the family, dance, sing and enjoy this special, holiday spectacular.

To pick up your exclusive game ball, visit the Harlem Globetrotters Merchandise Stand located inside the venue on game day. Pick-up is only available during pre-game, half-time, or post-game. Ball MUST be picked up at the venue on the date of your ticketed event. No alternate pick-up dates, locations, nor shipping options are available. This purchase is NON TRANSFERABLE.

events.name: MVP Court Pass (Check In By 1:30PM)
events.info: THIS IS AN OPTIONAL UPGRADE. TICKET TO THE MAIN EVENT IS ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer than courtside with the MVP Court Pass! Join the Pre-Game Fan Tunnel to welcome the Harlem Globetrotters to the floor, step into the Pre-Game Huddle, warm up with the team, and watch the famous Globetrotters Magic Circle from just feet away. This is MVP access on another level, and the perfect way to make a memory you'll talk about for years to come. With just 16 passes per game, this is the most exclusive 20 minutes in the arena. Check in at the announcer's table 30 mins prior to the game start. Late arrivals will not be refunded. All participants must have their own MVP Court Pass - no exceptions. Children under 10 must be with an adult who also has an MVP Court Pass. Soft or rubber-soled shoes required. This premium upgrade is not included with your game ticket. Don't miss your chance to be part of the Rivalry as an MVP!

events.name: Ultimate Fan Pass: 30-min Exclusive On-Court Access from 12:30-1:00 PM
events.info: TICKET TO MAIN EVENT ALSO REQUIRED. Get closer to the action with the all-new Ultimate Fan Pass - a limited-capacity, 30-minute pregame on-court experience featuring the Harlem Globetrotters and their Rivals. Be first through the doors and first on the court, where you get exclusive access up close with the players, learn trick shots from the pros, get one-of-a-kind photos, and kick off your own tip-off party before the rest of the crowd arrives. Ultimate Fan Pass guests also get first access to the merchandise stands before the lines form. A separate game ticket is required and is not included with this experience. Minors must be accompanied by an adult who also holds an Ultimate Fan Pass. Soft- or rubber-soled shoes are required on court. The on-court experience begins 90 minutes before game time. Late arrivals may miss some or all of the experience and are not eligible for refunds.

The Harlem Globetrotters - the team that invented basketball culture - bring the Rivalry Tour to your city as part of their 2027 world tour, with a roster of stars who turn every possession into showtime, quarter after quarter. This is a new experience - you're not just watching; you're part of it. You could get pulled onto the court. Join the squad. Own the jumbotron. Because anything can happen at a Globetrotters game. A free, all-new pre-game party kicks off the moment doors open, packed with new surprises for longtime fans and first-time families. This is Globetrotters joy - electric and built for YOU! The rivalry is theirs. The thrill is yours. Get your tickets now. events.name: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live Color Bash
events.info: Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live Color Bash takes the action to a whole new level, transforming the arena into a full-throttle collision of color. Vibrant paint-splattered trucks, bursts of color, and electrifying lighting turn every smash, and crash, into a vivid spectacle the whole family can see, feel, and remember. When the mischievous Skelesaurus drains all the color from Monster Truck Island, it's up to the crew of Rhinomite, Mega Wrex, Tiger Shark, Bone Shaker, and Bigfoot® to win it back - one massive stunt at a time, joined by a mysterious new ally! Every wheelie, jump, donut and freestyle run brings the color roaring back, building to a full-arena burst of light, sound, and pure Monster Truck energy. It's the show you love, reimagined like you've never seen it.

events.name: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs by the United European Ballet Company
events.info: Step into a magical fairytale world with Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs, a joyful ballet full of adventure, laughter, and unforgettable moments for the whole family. Presented by Classical Arts Entertainment, this vibrant production by the United European Ballet brings the beloved story to life through expressive dance, colorful characters, and enchanting storytelling. Set to the beautiful music of Bogdan Pavlovsky, the ballet follows the timeless tale of kind-hearted Snow White, the jealous Queen, and the seven charming dwarfs whose humor and personality fill the stage with joy and laughter.
